metadata.title: Alphabet's Not the Only AI Stock Tanking the Market

content.text:
9 hours ago
The tides have shifted on the AI trade yet again, and it was crushing the Nasdaq Composite.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell 1.6%. That's not to say the other major indexes weren't feeling the pressure. The S&P 500 dropped 0.5%, and the Dow declined 0.3%, or 184 points.
The selloff traces back to yesterday's weak earnings from Alphabet. The stock slumped nearly 13%, but that wasn't even the biggest laggard on the S&P 500.
